messages:
Sam: folks — analytics asked to persist some request headers for embedding debug traces. Is that allowed?

Mira: quick take: headers can be PII if they include session/auth or user ids. We should only keep a safe allowlist + transforms for identifiers.

Alex: they want to keep User-Agent, x-client-version, x-trace-id, and x-customer-id (hashed). Trace-id is useful for correlating logs.

Mira: UA + client-version OK. x-trace-id OK only if it's random and not derived from user. If trace ids contain user bits, redact.

Sam: about x-customer-id hashing — is a salted HMAC acceptable or do we need full redaction?

Jess: Security preference: irreversible transform using a KMS-backed HMAC is fine. Don't store raw values. If you need lookups, store truncated HMAC and an audit log.

Mira: implement transform in the logging pipeline:
```
# pipeline transform
if header_name == "x-customer-id":
  header_value = hmac_sha256(kms_key_arn, header_value)[:20]
  emit_audit_event("hashed-customer-id", trace_id)
```
Also ensure key rotation is enabled and access to decrypt/lookup requires an internal ticket.

LogBot: CONFIG SNIPPET:
```
logging.scrub.headers = ["authorization", "cookie", "x-session-token", "x-user-email"]
logging.allow.headers = ["user-agent", "x-client-version", "x-trace-id"]
logging.transforms = [{"header":"x-customer-id", "transform":"hmac_kms_truncate"}]
```

Alex: sounds good. We'll add the transform and open a ticket for analytics to get lookup privileges.

Sam: i'll update the PR and attach the ticket. @Jess can you ACK the access procedure once ticket is filed? :pray:

Jess: ACK in principle. Make sure the ticket includes: key ARN, rotation cadence, list of people who can request lookup, and SRE sign-off. :+1:

Sam: thanks — PR will reference ticket number when ready.
